scripts.rebuild: npm install && npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const p='cbt-results.json'; if(fs.existsSync(p)){ let d=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8')); let c=d.filter(r=>r.questionsSnapshot&&Object.keys(r.questionsSnapshot).length>0); fs.writeFileSync(p,JSON.stringify(c,null,2)); console.log('Cleaned '+(d.length-c.length)+' broken'); } else { console.log('No results file yet'); }"
